research.angle: Cece (測測, com.lingocc.cc5) by LIGHTFUL AI TECHNOLOGIES PTE. LTD. (Singapore) positions itself as a "know yourself, live positively" self-discovery super-app: professional astrology (20 chart types) + BaZi + Zi Wei fused with AI agent chat (3-second answers across star dice/tarot/bazi/natal tools), 50+ psychological tests, an MBTI-style 16-personality social layer (WeChat-friend synastry, friend-circle personality maps), a test-taker community, and paid certified experts — monetized via IAP from ~$0.70 to ~$115 per item. Critically, the Google Play build (1.0.9, 50K+ installs, no visible star rating) is a badly-maintained port of a much larger Chinese flagship (reviewers cite official version 10.36.0), with reviews revealing crash bugs in the synastry feature, forced login, overseas payment failure, no dark mode, and a cluttered content feed — a big exploitable gap for a polished international competitor.

Hard facts: title 測測 - 星座，八字，AI問答 (zh-CN: 测测 - 星座，八字，AI问答); developer LIGHTFUL AI / LIGHTFUL AI TECHNOLOGIES PTE. Teardown takeaway: the moat is the integrated stack (20 chart types + BaZi/ZiWei + AI Q&A over 5 divination tools + 16-personality social graph + expert marketplace); the exposed flank internationally is localization, build parity, payments, and dark-mode/UX polish.

research.angle: Feature-depth teardown of 测测 (Cece, App Store id756771906, pkg com.xxwolo.cc5 / intl com.lingocc.cc5, by 北京力拓飞远科技/Cece Group, CEO 任永亮, Tencent-invested) — China's most feature-dense astrology super-app. Core finding: it is a two-layer machine. Layer 1 is a free, genuinely deep divination toolbox (20 astrology chart types incl. progressions/returns/firdaria/solar-arc, bazi+ziwei+28 mansions+numerology, tarot, astro dice, 50+ psych tests) used as traffic. Layer 2 is the monetization engine: a paid human-expert marketplace (~20-26k certified 达人, voice Q&A from ¥3-30+/question, per-minute live calls 0.5-58.56 coins/min across 10 expert tiers, 30-50% platform take), coins (1币≈¥1, IAP ¥6-698), and VIP/SVIP subscriptions (¥9.9 first month→¥25/mo, ¥58/q, ¥178/yr, SVIP ¥69/mo). Since ~2020 it rebranded from 星座 app to "泛心理" (pan-psychology) AI community — adding 小测AI bot (~50k users/day), an AI virtual counselor, and a 3D psychological sandbox — without removing the mystic toolbox. 55M registered users, ~$5M+/yr App Store revenue, 80% female 16-28 core demo.

research.notes: Corrections vs. the task brief: the developer is 北京力拓飞远科技有限公司 (Beijing Light For You / Cece Group), not Shanghai 视辰; historical package is com.xxwolo.cc5 (xxwolo.com was the old domain), with com.lingocc.cc5 used on Google Play internationally; official site is cece.com (cecece.cn is a separate psych-testing site). Chart-type list: Chinese listings enumerate 14 named types (天象盘, 本命盘, 行运盘, 次限盘, 三限盘, 日返盘, 月返盘, 太阳弧, 法达 + 比较盘, 组合盘, 组合推运, 时空盘, 马克思盘) with '等...20种' phrasing — no source enumerates all 20; the remainder are likely harmonic/return variants. No evidence of a 择日 (date-selection) feature or 六爻; the dice divination is Western astro-dice (占星骰子). Expert count discrepancy: '2.6万签约达人' (26k) is sometimes mistranslated as 2.6M. Regulatory/PR risk is material: 800+ Black Cat complaints about induced spending (免密支付 auto-deduct, voucher bait), proxy certification exams (~¥2,000) — relevant if cloning the monetization design. Membership numbers verified on App Store CN: VIP ¥9.9 first month/¥25 renew, ¥58/q, ¥178/yr, SVIP ¥69/mo, coins ¥6-698.

research.notes: Caveats: (1) The app has two identities — legacy 测测星座 (com.xxwolo.cc5, CN) whose astrology depth (natal/synastry charts, ZiWei, 28 Mansions, Life Numbers, astro dice) comes from the official xxwolo.com product page (reached via English search; direct fetch 504'd) and journalism; the current CN/US iOS listing (id756771906) is rebranded as a women's emotional live-streaming community for regulatory reasons, so its store copy underplays divination. (2) The exact package researched, com.lingocc.cc5, is the international Traditional-Chinese build by 'LIGHTFUL AI' (only 10K+ Play downloads) whose title still says 星座/八字/AI問答 and whose description confirms AI tools = Star Dice, Tarot, BaZi with a 3-second-response claim, 20 chart/horoscope report types, MBTI + WeChat friend compatibility, 50+ tests. (3) No dedicated English blog reviews or AlternativeTo page exist; English coverage is journalism (Rest of World is the deepest) plus App Store material. Download figures vary by source (15M Apple vs 100M+ cumulative) — treat as different scopes.

research.angle: Review mining of Cece/测测 (Play com.lingocc.cc5 + iOS CN id 756771906 + expert app 测测达人版 id 1447926119): 150 recent Apple CN reviews, 51 Play reviews, both store descriptions, and press/search coverage. Reviews expose far more than listings: a 20-chart astrology engine with true-solar-time and 神煞 recalculations users notice, a five-type synastry suite recently paywalled, a per-minute human-expert marketplace with surge pricing, an AI persona layer (possibly Doubao-backed) with daily question quotas, and an AI soulmate-portrait generator — plus the monetization pain (¥10/min calls, ¥25/mo VIP, coins, ads) that dominates 1-star tails.
